es: Reseñar una película con descripción, dos deducciones sobre personajes, valoración con ejemplos, un defecto y una recomendación razonada.

vocabulary.es: no estar a la altura de
llevarse el protagonismo, robar la función

teaching.en: A gripping film holds your attention from the first scene, even when its uneven pacing makes the middle hour feel slow.
teaching.es: Una película absorbente capta tu atención desde la primera escena, incluso cuando su ritmo irregular hace que la hora central se sienta lenta.
teaching.explanationEs: Gripping describe lo que engancha; uneven pacing, un ritmo con altibajos.
segments: A gripping film holds your attention from the first scene, even
when its uneven pacing makes the middle hour feel slow.
teaching.audioText: A gripping film holds your attention from the first scene, even when its uneven pacing makes the middle hour feel slow.

teaching.en: The ending feels rushed: the editor can't have had enough time to finish the last scenes of a visually stunning film.
teaching.es: El final parece apresurado: el editor no puede haber tenido tiempo suficiente para terminar las últimas escenas de una película visualmente deslumbrante.
teaching.explanationEs: Can't have + participio deduce algo pasado; rushed describe lo hecho con prisa.
segments: The ending feels rushed: the editor can't have had enough time
to finish the last scenes of a visually stunning film.
teaching.audioText: The ending feels rushed: the editor can't have had enough time to finish the last scenes of a visually stunning film.

teaching.en: In an ensemble cast, a towering performance can steal the show, but it may also expose a flaw in the script.
teaching.es: En un reparto coral, una interpretación sobresaliente puede llevarse la película, pero también puede dejar al descubierto un defecto del guion.
teaching.explanationEs: Steal the show: destacar tanto que eclipsa al resto; flaw es un defecto concreto.
segments: In an ensemble cast, a towering performance can steal the show,
but it may also expose a flaw in the script.
teaching.audioText: In an ensemble cast, a towering performance can steal the show, but it may also expose a flaw in the script.

teaching.en: The main character must have suspected the truth, because he avoids his brother in every scene, which makes the drama convincing.
teaching.es: El protagonista tuvo que sospechar la verdad, porque evita a su hermano en cada escena, y eso hace creíble el drama.
teaching.explanationEs: Must have + participio: deducción casi segura apoyada en una pista; convincing = creíble.
segments: The main character must have suspected the truth, because he avoids
his brother in every scene, which makes the drama convincing.
teaching.audioText: The main character must have suspected the truth, because he avoids his brother in every scene, which makes the drama convincing.

teaching.en: Being utterly predictable is the film's only real flaw, and it is why the ending may fall short of the first hour.
teaching.es: Ser totalmente previsible es el único defecto real de la película, y por eso el final quizá no esté a la altura de la primera hora.
teaching.explanationEs: Fall short of + algo: quedarse por debajo de lo esperado.
segments: Being utterly predictable is the film's only real flaw, and it
is why the ending may fall short of the first hour.
teaching.audioText: Being utterly predictable is the film's only real flaw, and it is why the ending may fall short of the first hour.

teaching.en: A fair review names one flaw but still decides: I would recommend it to anyone who enjoys a slow, thoughtful story.
teaching.es: Una reseña justa señala un defecto pero decide igualmente: yo la recomendaría a cualquiera que disfrute de una historia lenta y reflexiva.
teaching.explanationEs: Recommend it to + persona, o recommend + -ing o that you + verbo; no se usa recommend + to + verbo.
segments: A fair review names one flaw but still decides: I would
recommend it to anyone who enjoys a slow, thoughtful story.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase valora con un ejemplo concreto, como pide una buena reseña?

choices.text: The dialogue is very good, and everybody will enjoy it without any doubt at all.
The dialogue is the main flaw, although the director probably did his best work.
The dialogue is convincing: in the kitchen scene, two short lines reveal a whole family history.

feedback.es: Solo la frase de la escena de la cocina apoya su opinión con un ejemplo concreto; las otras dan una opinión sin prueba o cambian de postura.

hint.es: Busca la opción que cita una escena concreta.

prompt.es: Completa: «El protagonista tuvo que saber la verdad; nunca mira a su hermano.»

feedback.es: Una pista clara permite una deducción casi segura sobre el pasado: must have + participio.

origin.text: In every scene, the main character avoids his brother. He ___ have known the truth, because he never once looks at him.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Yo se la recomendaría a cualquiera que disfrute de un misterio lento.»

answer.text: I would recommend it to anyone who enjoys a slow mystery

feedback.es: Recommend it to + persona cierra la reseña con una recomendación razonada.

hint.es: Después de recommend va it to, y luego anyone who.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué defecto señala el crítico en la película.

choices.text: The strong opening is followed by a hurried ending.
The final twist is ruined because the film ran out of money.
The long opening hour is slowed down by too many silences.

feedback.es: Elogia la primera hora y critica que el final se resuelva de golpe: el defecto es el ritmo apresurado; «ran out of money» es solo una comparación.

origin.audio: The first hour is gripping: the camera stays on faces, and every silence seems to hide something. But the last twenty minutes are a different film. The mystery is solved in one sentence, and the final twist feels rushed, as if the director had run out of money.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase de una reseña con la función que cumple.

pairs: The film follows a woman who returns to her village.
Her brother must have known more than he admits.
The pacing is uneven, and the ending feels rushed.
I would recommend it to anyone who likes quiet mysteries.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple un paso distinto de la reseña: describir, deducir, señalar un defecto y recomendar.

prompt.es: Completa: «La joven protagonista casi se lleva la película.»

feedback.es: Steal the show describe a quien destaca tanto que eclipsa al resto del reparto.

origin.text: The cast is excellent, but the young lead is so good that she almost ___ the show in every scene she appears in.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuál es la valoración global de la crítica.

choices.text: She thinks it is a great film, flaws included, and recommends it.
She recommends it despite clear weaknesses.
She enjoyed it more than she expected but hesitates to recommend it.

feedback.es: Admite defectos y dice que no es una gran película, pero la atrapó y acaba recomendándola con reservas.

origin.audio: I went in expecting very little, and I came out a little embarrassed by how much I had enjoyed it. The script is predictable, the music is far too loud and the young lead is given lines that no one could say with a straight face. And yet I could not look away. There is a scene in a kitchen, near the end, that I am still thinking about a week later. I would not call it a great film. I would, however, recommend it to anyone who has a free evening and an open mind.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se queda corta respecto a lo que prometían sus primeros diez minutos.»

feedback.es: Fall short of describe algo que queda por debajo de lo que prometía.

origin.text: The film is stunning to look at, but the story ___ short of the promise made by its first ten minutes.

prompt.es: ¿Qué deducción apoya mejor la escena descrita?

choices.text: She must have lived there for her whole life.
She might have visited once, but she has forgotten most of it.
She can't have been a stranger to the city.

feedback.es: Dar indicaciones y moverse con soltura contradice que sea una desconocida; decir que vivió allí toda la vida sería ir demasiado lejos, y olvidar una visita no explica su soltura.

origin.text: The mother insists that she has never been to the city. In one scene, however, she gives a waiter directions to a restaurant two streets away, and her hands know exactly where the cups are kept.

prompt.es: Escribe una reseña con dos deducciones, un ejemplo, un defecto y una recomendación.

answer.text: The Quiet Harbour follows a woman who returns to her fishing village after ten years and finds that nobody wants to talk about the night her father disappeared. From the first scene, the film is gripping: the camera stays on faces, and every silence seems to hide something. The cast is excellent, and the young lead almost steals the show. Her brother must have known more than he admits, because he never looks at her during the wedding, and the old neighbour, who says she never left her house, can't have stayed in that night, since her boots were covered in mud. The dialogue is convincing, for example in the kitchen scene, where two sentences reveal a whole family history. The one flaw is the pacing: the final twist feels rushed, and the ending may fall short of the promise of the first hour. Even so, I would highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys a slow, thoughtful mystery.
accepted: The Quiet Harbour follows a woman who returns to her fishing village after ten years and finds that nobody wants to talk about the night her father disappeared. From the first scene, the film is gripping: the camera stays on faces, and every silence seems to hide something. The cast is excellent, and the young lead almost steals the show. Her brother must have known more than he admits, because he never looks at her during the wedding, and the old neighbour, who says she never left her house, can't have stayed in that night, since her boots were covered in mud. The dialogue is convincing, for example in the kitchen scene, where two sentences reveal a whole family history. The one flaw is the pacing: the final twist feels rushed, and the ending may fall short of the promise of the first hour. Even so, I would highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys a slow, thoughtful mystery.

The Quiet Harbour is about a woman who goes back to her village by the sea after ten years. The film is stunning to look at and the actors are very good. Her brother must have hidden something from her, because he avoids her eyes at the wedding. The neighbour can't have stayed at home that night, since her boots were full of mud. The dialogue feels real, for instance in the kitchen scene, where a few words explain the whole family. The main weakness is that the story is predictable and the ending is rushed, so it falls short of its beginning. Nevertheless, I recommend it to everybody who likes slow films with a mystery, because the performances alone are worth the ticket.

feedback.es: Una reseña completa describe la película, deduce con modales perfectos, valora con un ejemplo, nombra un defecto y recomienda con una razón.

origin.text: Película ficticia «El puerto callado»: una mujer vuelve a su aldea pesquera tras diez años. Su hermano no la mira durante la boda, y la vecina, que jura que no salió de casa esa noche, tiene las botas llenas de barro. En una escena de la cocina, dos frases bastan para revelar toda la historia familiar. El reparto es excelente y los diálogos son creíbles, pero el final es apresurado. Escribe una reseña de al menos 120 palabras (lo ideal, 200).

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender la crítica sobre la película con sus elogios?

choices.text: She finds it acceptable but soon forgotten.
She dislikes it because it runs longer than promised.
She is impressed by its skill and its care.

feedback.es: Alaba solo lo básico (llegar a tiempo, enfocar) y señala que la sensación se esfumó: es un elogio frío que sugiere una película olvidable, no admiración ni queja por la duración.

origin.text: The film is well made. The actors arrive on time, the camera is usually in focus, and the ending comes, as promised, at ninety minutes. One could hardly ask for more, and one does not get it. I left the cinema in a good mood, which had gone before I reached the bus stop.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El ritmo es irregular y el giro final parece apresurado.»

answer.text: The pacing is uneven and the final twist feels rushed

feedback.es: Dos defectos unidos con and: el ritmo irregular y el giro final apresurado.

prompt.es: Completa: «El reparto es magnífico: hasta los papeles pequeños están cuidados.»

feedback.es: El reparto (cast) es el conjunto de actores de una película.

origin.text: Even the smallest roles are played with care. The ___ is excellent, and every scene feels lived in.
